description: Add users to a custom audience. Payload must be a JSON string containing hashed user data with a schema array defining the data types (e.g. EMAIL, PHONE, FN, LN).

payload.description: JSON string: {schema: ['EMAIL','PHONE',...], data: [['hash1','hash2',...], ...]}. All PII must be SHA-256 hashed.

name: add_users_to_audience
